title: Character sheets save twice in a row without a refresh
summary: Saving a character sheet now always remembers the new version, so you can save again straight away, even if the page couldn't reload the sheet after the first save.
items: If a save goes through but the reply is lost and you press Save again, the second press reports the first save instead of a conflict.
A real edit from another device is still refused, so nothing is overwritten.
